name: Lost
source:
A mysterious boy encountered at a construction site near Asakusa Station. He wears a light purple bear mask, so his real face is hidden. Despite meeting Memory for the first time, he acts strangely friendly, as if he's known Memory and her friends for a long time. He appears to be interested in Memory, but any attempts to confirm this result in him dodging the question with jokes.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
